prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1187; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Insured reports vehicle struck by oncoming sedan while turning left at intersection. Airbags deployed on insured's vehicle. Scene photos requested and received. Police report number pending.

Entry 2: Claimant contacted carrier through counsel. Representation letter received and logged. All further communication to be routed through claimant's attorney. Claimant reports knee injury from impact, currently under medical evaluation.

Entry 3: Recorded statement taken from insured. Insured states they had a green arrow signal but a second vehicle entered the intersection from the opposite direction. Liability appears disputed; investigation continuing. Requested signal timing data from the municipality.

Entry 4: Reviewed medical authorization submitted by claimant's counsel. Records request sent to treating orthopedic provider for knee imaging and treatment notes. Counsel advised that a demand package will follow once treatment is complete.

Entry 5: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding status. Counsel confirmed client is still undergoing physical therapy for the knee injury. Reserve reviewed and maintained pending receipt of medical records and independent review. Next follow-up scheduled for the coming week.
